cancel_observation.meaning: HTTP socket closed after observing open native reader; a boundary race is possible. No claim of immediate GPU read cancellation.

engine_evidence.scope: Only pump rows committed after reader start and before observed reader done. Final drain and ambiguous boundary pumps excluded; rows count native emitted BT output tokens (including termination), not API visible-content tokens or only accepted draft tokens.

intentional_cancel_native.scope: Only this exact observed reader may return read_ok=0; pump_ok must remain1. No allowance for another reader, suite, CUDA error, generated content, or failed retry.

cancel_log_window.scope: Only this cancelled admission; snapshot before HTTP shutdown, window sealed after server drain and native cancelled report, before same-request reuse.
